Asserts that the given lookup returns a non-null, non-empty string for the given key.

Asserts that the given lookup correctly handles all standard built-in prefix types: system properties (sys:), environment variables (env:), date formatting (date:), and Java runtime information (java:).
date: prefix formats the current date
java: prefix resolves JVM and runtime information
Bare key with no prefix resolves via the default (map) lookup
ctx: prefix also resolves via the default lookup
sys: prefix resolves via the system-property lookup (set in @BeforeAll)
Unknown key with no matching prefix or default entry returns null
ctx: prefix still resolves correctly after the failed lookup above
does not blow up and gives some kind of string.
